get.description:
This endpoint allows developers to retrieve a DMA Lead Generation Form.

#### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| owner | String | The URN of the organization |
| companyID | String | The ID of the company |
| q | String | The query parameter "owner" |

#### Response Fields

In the event of a successful request, the response will contain the following fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| paging | Object | Contains information about pagination |
| elements | Array | Contains the list of DMA Lead Generation Forms |
| owner | String | The owner of the DMA Lead Generation Form |
| hiddenFields | Array | Contains hidden fields for the form |
| versionId | Integer | The version ID of the form |
| created | Integer | The creation timestamp of the form |
| creationLocale | Object | Contains information about the creation locale |
| name | String | The name of the form |
| id | Integer | The ID of the form |
| lastModified | Integer | The last modified timestamp of the form |
| state | String | The state of the form |
| content | Object | Contains the content of the form |
| questions | Array | Contains the list of questions in the form |
| questionId | Integer | The ID of the question |
| question | Object | Contains the localized question text |
| responseEditable | Boolean | Indicates if the response is editable |
| name | String | The name of the question |
| questionDetails | Object | Contains details about the question |
| textQuestionDetails | Object | Contains details specific to text questions |
| maxResponseLength | Integer | The maximum length of the response for text questions |
| predefinedField | String | The predefined field for the question |
| responseRequired | Boolean | Indicates if the response is required |
| description | Object | Contains the localized description of the form |
| legalInfo | Object | Contains legal information for the form |
| consents | Array | Contains the list of consents for the form |
| consent | Object | Contains the localized consent text |
| checkRequired | Boolean | Indicates if the consent checkbox is required |
| id | Integer | The ID of the consent |
| legalInfoId | Integer | The ID of the legal information |
| privacyPolicyUrl | String | The URL to the privacy policy |
| legalDisclaimer | Object | Contains the localized legal disclaimer |
| headline | Object | Contains the localized headline of the form |

In the event of an error, the response will contain an 'error' object with a 'message' field describing the error.

This API endpoint makes an HTTP GET request to retrieve information about DMA lead generation forms. The request URL is `{{baseUrl}}/dmaLeadGenForm` with a query parameter `ids` that takes a list of lead generation form URNs.

### Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| owner | String | The URN of the organization |
| leadGenFormID | String | The ID of the leadGenForm |
| q | String | The query parameter "owner" |

### Response Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| results | Object | A dictionary containing the information about the lead generation forms. |
| results.{form_urn} | Object | Information about a specific lead generation form identified by its URN. |
| results.{form_urn}.owner | String | The owner of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.hiddenFields | Array | A list of hidden fields in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.versionId | Integer | The version ID of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.created | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was created. |
| results.{form_urn}.creationLocale | Object | The locale (country and language) in which the lead generation form was created. |
| results.{form_urn}.name | String | The name of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.id | Integer | The ID of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.lastModified | Integer | The timestamp of when the lead generation form was last modified. |
| results.{form_urn}.state | String | The state of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content | Object | The content of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions | Array | A list of questions in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].name | String | The name of a question in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails | Object | Details about a question in the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails | Object | Details specific to a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails.options | Array | A list of options for a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.questions\[\].questionDetails.multipleChoiceQuestionDetails.options\[\].text | String | The text of an option for a multiple-choice question. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.description | String | The description of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo | Object | Information about the legal aspects of the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents | Array | A list of consents required by the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents\[\].consent | Object | Information about a consent required by the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.consents\[\].checkRequired | Boolean | Indicates whether the consent is required to submit the form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.privacyPolicyUrl | String | The URL to the privacy policy associated with the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.legalInfo.legalDisclaimer | Object | The legal disclaimer associated with the lead generation form. |
| results.{form_urn}.content.headline | String | The headline of the lead generation form. |
| statuses | Object | A dictionary containing the statuses of the lead generation forms. |
| statuses.{form_urn} | Integer | The status of a specific lead generation form identified by its URN. |
| errors | Object | A dictionary containing any errors that occurred during the request. |

Please note that the actual values of the fields may vary and have been omitted in this description for brevity.

textBlock.content: Notre Dame Cathedral, an enduring symbol of Paris, stands gracefully on the Île de la Cité, surrounded by the flowing waters of the Seine. This architectural marvel, with its stunning Gothic design and rich history, has captured the hearts of millions of visitors over the centuries.

Construction of Notre Dame began in the 12th century and continued for almost two hundred years, culminating in a structure that seamlessly blends intricate stonework with breathtaking stained glass windows. The cathedral's iconic flying buttresses and majestic spire, tragically lost in the 2019 fire, have left an indelible mark on the city's skyline.

Stepping into Notre Dame, visitors are enveloped in an atmosphere of reverence and grandeur. The nave's towering arches and the play of light filtering through the rose windows create a sense of divine inspiration. The cathedral's interior is adorned with sculptures, religious artifacts, and historic relics, each telling a story that spans centuries.

The heart of Notre Dame is its magnificent organ, a masterpiece of craftsmanship and musicality. The echoes of organ music within the sacred walls add a spiritual dimension to the visitor's experience, making a visit to Notre Dame not only a visual feast but also a symphony for the soul.

While Notre Dame faced a devastating fire in 2019, the commitment to its restoration has been unwavering. Donations and support from around the world have fueled the restoration efforts, ensuring that this iconic landmark will once again stand proudly on the Parisian skyline.

In conclusion, Notre Dame Cathedral is more than a historic monument; it is a living testament to the resilience and spirit of Paris. As restoration work progresses, the cathedral continues to draw visitors who seek to witness not only its architectural splendor but also the enduring legacy of a symbol that has withstood the test of time. Notre Dame remains, and will always be, a timeless icon that embodies the heart and soul of Paris.
